changes: All 30 units and structures have distinct silhouettes, movement and working parts. Open the Field Guide to rotate a model and see its stats and poses.
Preview buildings on their exact tiles and see area spells before casting. Thinner territory lines keep units visible when armies converge on a shrine.
Bows, siege shells, lightning and spores have distinct sounds and impacts. Deliveries, finished recruits, research and captured shrines get their own feedback and a match recap.
Crowded battles animate more smoothly. Sound and motion controls are available in setup and during play, and the first launch on Mac follows your Reduce Motion setting.
